# Architecture Decision Record Template

## Status
Proposed | Accepted | Superseded | Rejected

## Context
What system/product problem exists? Which current rules/contracts/source evidence constrain the decision? Why is this consequential enough for an ADR?

## Decision
State one decision in enforceable terms. Include affected scope and effective date/revision.

## Alternatives considered
For each viable alternative: benefits, failure modes, migration/operational cost, why not selected.

## Consequences
Positive/negative consequences, new coupling, performance/security/tenant implications, operational burden and future reversibility.

## Migration / adoption
Files/contracts/schema/gates/docs changed; compatibility period; rollout order; removal of old design.

## Proof
Tests/gates/metrics or review evidence that demonstrate the decision is actually implemented.

## Related rules / ADRs / exceptions
Stable IDs/links.
